segment_contamination_dimensions: General-purpose portable cabin buyers (office, security, classroom, kitchen, accommodation use) — these buyers are not seeking ATM-specific security features, compact ATM footprint, or bank/WLA deployment requirements; names must not attract them by omitting ATM-specific context.

Material-type cabin buyers searching generic sibling MCATs (MS Porta Cabin, GI Portable Cabin, FRP Cabin, PUF Cabin, Modular Portable Cabin) — names must retain 'ATM' as a mandatory qualifier to prevent routing to generic cabin categories.

Security cabin buyers (Security Cabins, Portable Security Cabins, FRP Portable Security Cabin, Prefabricated Security Cabin, MS Security Cabins) — ATM cabins share security door features but serve a distinct banking-infrastructure buyer persona; names must not be reducible to generic security cabin descriptors.
